from __future__ import annotations
from dataclasses import dataclass


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class UserCreatedData:
    enabled: bool
    always_true: str
    nothing: None
    maybe: bool | None = None
    always_false: str = None
    flags: list[bool] | None = None

    @classmethod
    def from_dict(cls, data: dict[str, Any]) -> UserCreatedData:
        return cls(
            enabled=data.get("enabled"),
            always_true=data.get("alwaysTrue"),
            nothing=data.get("nothing"),
            maybe=data.get("maybe"),
            always_false=data.get("alwaysFalse"),
            flags=data.get("flags"),
        )

    def to_dict(self) -> dict[str, Any]:
        return {
            "enabled": self.enabled,
            "alwaysTrue": self.always_true,
            "nothing": self.nothing,
            "maybe": self.maybe,
            "alwaysFalse": self.always_false,
            "flags": self.flags,
        }
